请从 Finder 直接启动 Tauge.app（不要在受限沙盒或只读环境中运行: Launch Tauge.app directly from Finder (don't run it in a restricted sandbox or read-only volume); you can also move the database to a writable location in Settings → Advanced.

请先在代理设置里点「测试」：它会把「到代理的 TCP 不通」和「代理拒绝这条隧道: Click “Test” in the proxy settings first: it tells “can’t reach the proxy over TCP” apart from “the proxy refused the tunnel”, then follow its hints to check the address, type, or account.

请把「连接方式」改为系统 ssh，或直接连接让 Tauge 自动切换。: set “Connection Method” to system ssh, or connect directly and let Tauge switch automatically.
请把「高级 → 连接方式」改回「自动」或「内置」——内置 SSH 栈支持 HTT: Set Advanced → Connection Method back to “Automatic” or “Built-in” — the built-in SSH stack supports full HTTP CONNECT / SOCKS5 authentication.
请检查主机地址拼写，或确认当前网络可以解析该域名。: Check the host address for typos, or make sure the current network can resolve that domain.
请检查数据库文件是否被占用或损坏，可在“设置 → 高级”中导出或迁移数据库。: Check whether the database file is in use or damaged. You can export or move the database in Settings → Advanced.
请检查用户名、密码或私钥是否匹配，以及服务器是否允许该认证方式。: Check that the username, password, or private key matches, and that the server allows this authentication method.
请检查该文件是否被占用或损坏；也可以在“设置 → 高级”中迁移数据库到可写位置。: Check whether the file is in use or damaged; you can also move the database to a writable location in Settings → Advanced.
请清理磁盘空间后重试。数据库位于“设置 → 高级”显示的位置。: Free up some disk space and try again. The database is at the location shown in Settings → Advanced.
请确认主机在线、端口正确，并检查防火墙或安全组设置。: Make sure the host is online and the port is correct, then check the firewall or security group settings.
请至少填写名称或地址: Enter at least a name or an address
请退出 Tauge 并重新启动，之后的所有修改都会保存到新位置。: Quit Tauge and reopen it. All changes after that are saved in the new location.
